title: EXAMPLES-002: `driver` is uninitialized when `indigo_load_driver()` fails, but `indigo_remove_driver(driver)` is still called
summary: EXAMPLES-002: `driver` is uninitialized when `indigo_load_driver()` fails, but `indigo_remove_driver(driver)` is still called. A missing simulator driver or load error can therefore pass an indeterminate pointer into the driver manager. Initialize `driver = NULL` and call `indigo_remove_driver()` only after a successful load. Fixed: Initialize driver entry; remove only after successful load, disconnect before unload, and propagate load/unload failures.
